recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If mustSupport snapshot preservation fails in a modern IG or the current external publisher, fix that in the relevant IG/tooling project rather than in current FHIR core source.
issue_request: FHIR-5980 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 correction reporting that QICore ProcedureRequest set mustSupport=true in the differential but the generated XML and HTML snapshot view did not preserve that flag.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-5980. The Jira comment from Grahame Grieve says the defect already looked fixed shortly after it was reported. Nearby history shows QICore ProcedureRequest must-support source work before the report, but the missing flag was a generated-artifact/tooling symptom rather than a current hand-authored source defect.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini records ProcedureRequest as merged into ServiceRequest, and source/igs.xml comments out the historical QICore IG entry. The active ElementDefinition.mustSupport source says snapshots SHOULD always populate mustSupport. FHIR-5580 reported the same class of DSTU1 snapshot/differential mismatch, and FHIR-6000 records a related derived-profile publisher failure already audited on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Adding new core prose or editing disabled historical QICore material would not improve the current specification because the active source already states the required snapshot behavior and the affected generated QICore page is not in current build scope.
